requirements.title: SET_EXPONENT result value follows zero IEEE and exponent rules
requirements.definition: SET_EXPONENT returns zero unchanged for zero X, an IEEE NaN for IEEE infinity, the same NaN for IEEE NaN, and otherwise X*b**(I-e) using the real model exponent e.

pending.SET_EXPONENT-zero-same-value: Initialize the observed result to -1.0, call SET_EXPONENT(0.0,-1), assert result==0.0, and include SET_EXPONENT(3.0,EXPONENT(3.0)+2) as a nonzero companion.
pending.SET_EXPONENT-infinity-gives-NaN: An IEEE-capability-gated fixture creates positive infinity with IEEE_VALUE and asserts IEEE_IS_NAN(SET_EXPONENT(infinity,1)); non-IEEE runs are outside this facet.
pending.SET_EXPONENT-NaN-propagates: An IEEE-capability-gated fixture creates a quiet NaN with IEEE_VALUE, asserts IEEE_IS_NAN(SET_EXPONENT(nan_value,1)), and records no portable payload-identity oracle.
pending.SET_EXPONENT-model-exponent-value: Use X1=3.0 with I1=EXPONENT(X1)+2 and X2=-0.75 with I2=-1, chosen inside the real model exponent range; assert FRACTION(SET_EXPONENT(X1,I1))==FRACTION(X1), EXPONENT(SET_EXPONENT(X1,I1))==I1, FRACTION(SET_EXPONENT(X2,I2))==FRACTION(X2), and EXPONENT(SET_EXPONENT(X2,I2))==I2; mutate I1 by one.
